title: Not helpful at all
body: Meals didn’t taste good

title: Best app ever!
body: This app is the app of my dreams! It has revolutionized my life — I adore that I can meal plan, make a grocery list, and have my recipes all in the same app. Love the link to the recipe in the meal planning feature and that the grocery list will pull from the meal plan. Are there some tweaks that would make it even better and more streamlined — yes (it would be great to select the week I want to shop for when creating my grocery list; I would also love being able to click and drag my recipes around on the meal planning app instead of having to edit and select the day) but I seriously recommend this to everyone! It’s essential for every individual, and it’s like having a personal assistant for busy moms!

title: Love it!
body: This app is so great. I love that I can import recipes and it helps me meal plan. Highly recommend!

title: Amazing App
body: The most convenient app to organize recipes you find across all different platforms. No more scrolling through your photo library and trying to follow 5 different screen shots. Get it, you won’t regret it!

I love this app so so much! The only paid app I’ve ever bought and soooo worth the money! I can get in and out of the grocery store so quickly without forgetting anything and I’m actually cooking food that I love again! Thank you 🥹🤍

title: Amazing!
body: This app has been so helpful in being more efficient with meals and meal planning. There are so many practical and wonderful features. It’s very intuitive and user-friendly. If I could give it more stars I would.

title: Love
body: So helpful! Thank you for creating this app.

title: A MUST HAVE
body: Do you feel like something is missing in your life? I can almost guarantee it is this app!!!!! Are you type A? This is for you!!!! Are you a wife? A Mom? This is for you!!! This is 1000% going to make your life easier! The amount of thought that went into how this functions shows. Moving all your recipes into one place and doing the work for you! This is legit genius. Allowing all family members to be connected and add their wants/needs to the grocery list without my brain having to do all the work... thank you! This app is so beautifully created and effortlessly easy to use. Absolutely a necessity for any family large or small.

title: Perfect meal planning app!
body: I love this app so far! They seemingly thought of everything. I love how easy it is to import recipes and also that it automatically reformats them so it is clean and easy to read. Another favorite feature is that you can add notes for the day under the meal planning section so if there is an event, I can notate it. Last but not least, you can add someone to your household which makes it super easy to share responsibility with meal planning and grocery lists.

title: Literally amazing
body: I didn’t event know I was quite looking for an app like this for forever … so this is amazing. I have followed feeding littles for a couple years now and have loved their recipes, both books, etc since we started baby led weaning with our now 3 year old… but this app is everything I needed and more for organizing all of our recipes!!!! From insta recipes to misc online ones to even pictures of our printed cookbooks, I have everything in one organized place now. And it’s so easy to save from insta and sites. Cannot recommend enough!!!!

title: So great!
body: It is amazing being able to save all the recipes in one place that’s easy to access (instead of scrolling through screenshots and open tabs when I am planning meals for the week); and being able to save grocery lists for stores, and add things to my shopping list right from the meal plan for the week is also super helpful. Highly recommend!!

title: So easy, so helpful, shareable!
body: This app has so many cool components. Easy to upload recipes, easy to map out the week, easy to move things around if needed, grocery list option (with checkmarks!), and I love the family sharing so husband and babysitters can see it all!

title: Life Saver!
body: Just watched the shortcut on how to import recipes! Going through every bookmarked recipe I have that I never made and now I will with it all in one place!! Such a great idea!

title: Exactly what I needed!
body: This app is INCREDIBLE. It allows me to save all of my recipes in one place, categorize them, and if I make a meal plan for the week it will auto create a grocery list for me! So user friendly - you can tell they put the time and effort in to test everything, make sure it worked correctly, and make sure it was easy because busy parents have enough going on. Truly a tool that makes life easier!

title: Just keeps getting better!
body: I gave this app 5 stars about a month ago when I first started using it, and it just keeps getting better and better! They are continuously improving it, making it easier to navigate and use. The recent community section is amazing for inspiration! Every time I use this app, I feel happier, and that’s not an exaggeration. It’s helped me clear so much mental load that I’ve even downloaded a home cleaning app that I used to be too overwhelmed to use. I feel like I’ve gained back hours and peace and am able to better use my time. Thank you for such a great app!

title: A Busy Mom’s New Best Friend
body: I am loving this app! I have hundreds of recipes saved in all kinds of places and am always searching for the one I’m looking for, not remembering if it was saved on FB, Insta, Pinterest, etc. I love having everything in one spot. I LOVE that my screen doesn’t go to sleep while I’m cooking. I love that there’s no ads that I accidentally click on and get all messed up. I haven’t explored all the ways to use the app, but am loving it so far. Megan gets us, moms!!

title: Get this now!
body: I love this app. My husband and I use it daily! The grocery list function is next level and I really love importing recipes from Instagram! I used to save them or take screenshots but then I would forget about them and never make them. Now I know I have them in my app! Get it now, you’ll thank me later!

title: Finally an All in One App for Meal Planning with Kids
body: Love this app! Being able to write a list on paper snap and pic to import it into the app is so helpful for me, I don’t always make lists on my phone. And it’s been so fun putting all my Pinterest saved recipes into the app, and adding the items straight into a grocery list, GAME CHANGER. We’ve made a few recipes already and they have been so yummy, my kids actually ate the broccoli! Highly recommend the app!

title: A must-have for everyone!
body: It honestly makes my life so much easier - I can meal plan for everyone (even if we’re having different meals bc of crazy schedules), make a grocery list (with pictures!), save recipes from literally anywhere & organize it in a way that makes sense to me! The free recipes have also all been hits with my kids! Seriously, it’s the best app ever.

title: Excellent resource
body: This app is fantastic! Layout is clean and beautiful, easy to navigate and so helpful. Very Feeding Littles-like! ♥️

title: Great app and phenomenal customer support
body: Finally I have a place to save all the Instagram reel recipes I save but then lose in the abyss, plus adding my faves from cookbooks and blogs. Love it! The best part? The customer support. Once I DMd the creator on Instagram asking if a feature was available and I was just missing it - she asked me follow up questions and the feature was added the next day. Then I had an issue importing a recipe - clicked the “report a problem” button and a few days later got a personal email that it was fixed with another app update. Unparalleled app both for ease of use/making my life better and for the superb support. Highly recommend!

title: So helpful!
body: I love their cookbooks and this feels like the way to wrap it all up into a super helpful and usable tool. Thank you Feeding Littles for all your amazing work!

title: Meals made for real life.
body: Plenty of healthy, easy kid friendly recipes! But what sold me is the quick and easy recipe suggestions, including box mac & cheese, dino nuggets, and order pizza (all with healthy additions). This app gets it!

title: I LOVE IT
body: I have been using this app for weekly meal planning for the last several weeks, and it has been a huge help. I’m always finding recipes on social media and have a million screen shots and tabs open that I’ll never go back to, but this changed the game for me! I was able to cancel our meal box subscription because I finally feel like I can get dinner on the table without it. Soo worth the price!!

title: Love!
body: So easy to use!!! I love the meal plan feature! And it’s free!

title: Brilliant, organizing and easy!
body: I first got the app because I love the recipes from FL’s lunch book and Instagram. Then I realized with a few clicks I can save recipes from Instagram and my browser to this app and in an organized way without having to read/skip paragraphs of unneeded info! Plus it’s easier when actually cooking because unlike Instagram if I put my phone down to do a step- the app will stay on the recipe so I don’t have to go searching for the recipe again!

title: Game changer!
body: I love this app! The free included recipes and drag-and-drop meal planning make life so much easier. My favorite is the ability to save and organize recipes from social media, websites and blogs, or even upload handwritten family favorites ..all in one place! Dinner time is so much less stressful now that I can browse all my saved collections!

title: The best tool
body: My husband and I are constantly sharing recipes back and forth in instagram DMs, texts, photos, etc. Having an easy way to plan our weeks, keep those recipes in a single place, and share the finalized plan one another is a total game changer. No more saying “what other recipes did we buy for this week” to each other on a nightly basis. Kudos!

title: “What’s for Dinner?” just got easier!
body: Feeding Littles just made feeding my family so much easier. The recipes are quick, realistic, and actually work for busy parents who don’t have time to think every night. It’s helped us break out of our same boring meals, and I love how easy the app is to navigate and search. The meal-planning feature alone is a game changer! No more screenshotting videos I’ll never find again. Love it!

title: Life saver
body: This solved the problem of what’s for dinner tonight.

title: Recipes
body: This app is immediately a winner! Can share recipes to it and it finds just the recipe and formats it perfectly!

title: Incredible app
body: This has been so helpful for discovering recipes and planning the meals I cook for my kids throughout the week!

title: Finally!!
body: It is so exciting to have a go-to place to store all of the recipes we want to try across platforms. The recipes that are already on the app are great (easy and healthy for busy parents) but this feature really changes the game!! I’ve already gone through and added recipes from Instagram and the transfer was really simple and comprehensive!

title: So easy and convenient!!
body: I love using Feeding Littles for the recipe and meal plan functions! It is so nice having all my recipes in the same place with a very user friendly interface. The meal plan functions makes it so easy to plan my meals for the week and what I need to buy at the grocery store. I would highly recommend giving Feeding Littles a shot if you want to make your life easier :)

title: Game Changer
body: I love this app so much. I have recipes I use from cook books, chatgpt, YouTube, etc. It's amazing to be able to consolidate them all into one place with such a convenient interface. I can literally send the app a screenshot, a copy and paste, or importing from a website and it will organize it all for you into an easy to read format. So easy to edit and add photos and notes as well. Having all these recipes organized into different categories like breakfast, desserts, sourdough breads, smoking meats, etc will really speed things up and make quick meals for a family with young kids very accessible. I love it!!

title: Really helpful app for planning meals
body: Getting healthy meals on the table is a constant stress of mine, and I’ve found the Feeding Littles app a really great way to help keep me organized and to stay inspired. I appreciate that you can import recipes from other sources to set up your meal plans, and I really love the inspiration from the recipes in the app. Thank you Feeding Littles!

title: Credible High Quality Content Now in an App!
body: I am thrilled to see the Feeding Littles resources expand into an app. And to be free to our family is such a gift as we walk our young kids through these important food-introductory years. Thank you!

title: Great app for food lovers!
body: I have kids who are 8 and 10, and this app has already made meal planning much easier! The best feature is saving recipes directly from Instagram and food blogs. I quickly catalogue recipes I like and turn them into weekly meal plans. The process feels fast and intuitive. I was surprised by how easy it is to save recipes I see and want to try later. I recommend this app to everyone, not only parents.

title: Painless way to add all Your Family’s Favorite Recipes in one place
body: What I love most about this app is the ability to edit and add notes to recipes I’ve tried and modified to fit my family’s preferences. It is so incredibly easy to import all my favorite recipes online & my many recipe books with post-it notes all over. It even recognized my handwritten notes and added the detail that mattered to the recipe! I use this app every week to plan our family’s dinners and every time I cook.

title: Feeding Littles has done it again!!
body: This app is so easy to use and really accounts for the reality of meal planning for a family! I have followed Megan’s loose meal plans on IG for years, so to have that flexible style of meal planning and all the tips in one place is amazing!

title: Love this app!
body: I’ve been a big fan of Megan and Feeding Littles since my 8 yr old was an infant. Both my kids did the baby led weaning and are great eaters (most of the time)! This app is amazing - in less than 5 minutes I planned my meals for the week with delicious recipes I recognize from the Feeding Littles cookbooks (and more)! What a great surprise to have an app to support the chaos of family meal planning. Love it!

title: Game Changer!
body: This app has been a game changer! I needed an app to save the countless recipes I had stored in a bunch of different places. I now have everything in one place making planning for the week so much easier. I also love that there are already a ton of recipes built into the app to get you started.
